subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this remain one broad browser/search hardening tracker, or should maintainers split it into narrower browser-backed access, external browser endpoint, search-provider hardening, and benchmark-matrix work before implementation?
rationale: The current issue crosses product direction and security boundaries; automation cannot safely choose whether browser rendering belongs inside web_fetch/web_search, a browser plugin/backend, or only an evaluation matrix.

options.title: Split into staged tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer scoping, then move approved slices into narrower issues with concrete security and validation criteria.

options.title: Keep as umbrella tracker
options.body: Use this issue as a single human-owned coordination item and do not queue implementation until maintainers add the matrix and acceptance criteria.

options.title: Close after delegating to existing issues
options.body: Close this only if maintainers explicitly decide that the remaining work is fully owned by the open browser-backed access and external endpoint issues.

recommendation.title: Split into staged tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer scoping, then move approved slices into narrower issues with concrete security and validation criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: History points most strongly to this owner for browser plugin, sandbox browser policy, and web-tool boundary decisions.
